sample_pdf_random: sample random values from a PDF defined by bin edges and weights using the C++ accelerated function
sample_pdf_deterministic: sample deterministic uniformly-spaced values from a PDF using bin edges and weights with det=True
sample_pdf_python_large_bins: sample values from a PDF using the pure Python implementation optimized for large bin counts
sample_pdf_python_cdf_inversion: invert a cumulative distribution function to generate samples from bin edges and weights in pure Python
refactor_sample_pdf_differentiability: refactor sample_pdf to support gradient computation when bins or weights require gradients
